AdjustmentWriter.ValidateSchema, SystemPlanRepository.ValidateSystemSchema and StorageSchema.IsElementSchemaCompatible compare schema names and required simple string fields. StorageSchemaFieldValidatorTests checks field names, types and containers. EvaluateSelection catches schema identity collisions, logs a warning and returns hasElements = false. For a schema field change, use a distinct GUID. Add the prior (Id, Name) to StorageSchema.RetiredElementSchemas or StorageSchema.RetiredSystemSchemas. DIAGNOSTICS ErftNew in build/Distribution/tool-contracts.json declares the command type and window title. DevModeScenarioTests.Verified_proxies_match_the_tool_contract checks the command proxy. DevModeScenarioTests.Routes excludes the pick route. TargetSelectionPicker ties each prompt to its own Revit pick. NotificationBannerHost logs the prompt text when it closes. AdjustmentEvaluator keeps the original offsets on error rows and records the reason in ErrorMessage. The Status cells show that reason as a tooltip. An underside miss can report the plan distance. A failed follower names the followed end and its support when available. For Apply alerts, see WindowSession.ShowNoPlanToApply, ShowApplyFailure and ShowApplySuccess. See SourceSelectionPicker.ShowConcreteFilterToast for the concrete-filter message and WindowSession.ShowSelectionDiagnostic for selection messages. ErftNewCommand.RunAsync defines New/RunFailed. ErftContextualRibbonInjector.RunEditFlow defines Edit/RunFailed. FramingAdjustmentFailure.Tag formats codes as [SpecFail/<code>]. TESTS ./test.sh test --tool ERFT --scope pure ./test.sh test --tool ERFT --scope local -y 2026 ErftRevitTestBase resolves <year>/GM/gm_test_model.rvt. TargetGeometryReaderTests checks a footprint roof's base-level label, projection to a steep roof's underside, and the floor geometry cut by a joined column. FramingAdjustmentEndToEndTests checks removal of retired entities and emptied DataStorage records in 2027/Regression/realtest_model.rvt (-y 2027). See Model paths. SEE ALSO Hooks, Structural Preview

developer-guide/tools/experimental/recor.title: dbtools.RecordSet | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/experimental/recor.summary: dbtools.RecordSet NAME dbtools.RecordSet - the assembly behind Record Set SYNOPSIS source src/Tools/Experimental/RecordSet/ (manifest.yml) assembly dbtools.RecordSet entry RecordSetToolModule command RecordSetCommand (run profile InlineUi) views App/Views/RecordSetWindow.xaml, Features/ManageItems/Views/ManageItemsWindow.xaml controls src/dbtools.Presentation/Tools/RecordSet/ policy Policies/recordset_policy.json (dbtools.ToolConfigs.RecordSet.recordset_policy.json) script Features/Operations/Cad/CoreConsole/Scripts/rs_xrefs.lsp (dbtools.ToolCad.RecordSet.rs_xrefs.lsp) DESCRIPTION RecordSetCommand calls AppLauncher.Launch, which opens the modal Record Set window. The window builds an ExecutionPlan, an ordered list of PlanItem records, and shows it as a tree. Planning reads files, Revit TransmissionData and Core Console listings, and writes nothing to the target. ExecutionPlanExecutor runs the plan and is the only writer there. The user page describes the behavior. STRUCTURE Paths are under src/Tools/Experimental/RecordSet/. Path Contents App/Composition/ RecordSetToolModule calls AddRecordSet. AppLauncher builds RecordSetWindowServices and RecordSetWindowViewModel. App/ViewModels/ The view model, in partial files. RecordSetPreviewSyncCoordinator runs the preview 350 ms after the last change. Features/Domain/ SourceFile, HostModel, PlanContext, ExecutionPlan, the plan items and PlanMessage. Features/Planning/ HostImporter, PlanningService, TargetPathRules, CadXrefDiscovery, PlanningLimits, and the Preview/ builders. Features/Execution/ ExecutionPlanExecutor, and PlanExecutionWorkflow, which owns the overlay and the result alert. Features/Operations/ SafeFileSystemOperations, RevitOperations, and Cad/ with CadPreviewer, CadExecutor and CoreConsole/. Features/Policy/ PolicyReader, FilePolicyEvaluator and PolicyGlobMatcher. Features/Metadata/, Features/ManageItems/ The name catalogs. The view model applies the CatalogEdit lists of MetadataCatalogWorkflow. CONTRACTS Common links. PlanningService.BuildContext counts links by ExternalReferenceKey: the full path from WindowsPathOperations.NormalizeCaseFullPath, and the LinkType. A key that occurs twice or more is common, and TargetPathRules.ComputeLinkTargetPath puts it in Common Linked Files. PlanningWorkflowTests and TargetPathRulesTests check this. Destinations. PreviewDestinationAllocator keeps one source for each destination. Another source gets name (n).ext, with the lowest free n from 2, and the plan gets a Warning. PreviewDestinationAllocatorTests checks this. The planners publish a destination when they schedule its copy. PreviewDestination.FileCopy supplies a source file to the tree. PreviewDestination.FolderCopy supplies the fallback Xref folder. PreviewPlanBuilderTests compares the tree with the plan. Embedded policy. PolicyReader reads only the embedded resource. ValidatePolicy throws for a policy that breaks its schema, and for a root that is not a drive path or a complete UNC share. No code reads delete_mode, require_sentinel_for_delete or SafeOperationRuntime.TrashRoot. PolicyReaderTests checks this. Preflight. Before the lock, ValidatePreconditions reloads the policy, checks the root, and checks that each output path of each item is under the target. It requires free space minus max(TotalBytes, PredictedOutputBytes) to be at least min_free_bytes (10 GiB in the shipped policy). A failure writes no lock and no manifest. ExecutionPlanExecutorTests checks this. Contained writes. SafeFileSystemOperations resolves junctions and other redirects before each containment check. A link resolution error refuses the path and identifies the link. A directory copy checks all selected destinations before creating folders or copying files. CAD and Revit items check their host path again directly before the adapter call. The check and the write are separate operations, so a path that changes between them is not caught. SafeFileSystemOperationsTests checks the redirects. Lock and manifest. The lock uses FileMode.CreateNew. After the lock, the executor writes a manifest with the status ok, cancelled or failed, and always tries to release the lock. cancelled needs owner cancellation, and the window passes CancellationToken.None. FailurePrecedence rethrows a single failure, or throws an AggregateException of all failures, the first one first. ExecutionPlanExecutorTests checks this. Bind All. The preview plans CadBindAllItem only when CadXrefDiscovery.BindRefusals is empty for the whole Xref graph. Before each bind, the executor lists the graph again and throws on a refusal. PreviewPlanBuilderTests and PlanExecutionWorkflowTests check this. Core Console results. CoreConsoleRuntime.RunScriptAsync accepts a run only with exit code 0 and a result file whose JSON has "ok": true. CadExecutor also requires changed to name every planned Xref, and unbound to be empty. CadExecutorTests checks this. Revit repath. RevitOperations reads desired reference data when the file is transmitted, else last-saved data. It skips PathType.Content. It resolves a relative path from the host folder, or from the central folder for a workshared local. It keeps the path type and the load state. It writes only when a reference changes, and then sets IsTransmitted = true. The Revit test TransmissionDataAdapterTests checks all but the central folder. CAD options. A null PlanOptions member follows Core Console availability in each preview, until the user changes an option. PreviewPlanStateTests and RecordSetWindowViewModelTests check this. Execute failures. ExecuteAsync records a failure through RunWithoutThrowingAsync. The App's default notifier shows an Error banner with Details. Clicking Details opens the logger window. ExecuteCommand_WhenCompletionAlertFails_ContainsFailureAndRestoresBusyState checks this for one failure. FLOW HostImporter.ImportHosts calls PlanningService.ScanHost for each host. A RevitOperationException rejects only that host. Each edit clears the preview. The debounced sync calls PlanExecutionWorkflow.SyncPreviewAsync in Task.Run. PreviewPlanBuilder.BuildPlanAsync runs PreviewPlanState.Create (finds Core Console), PreviewHostPlanner.PlanHostsAndLinks, PreviewCadPlanner.PlanAsync (each DWG destination once, with the CAD settings of its first host), PlanRevitRepaths, PreviewPlanTotals.CountCopyBytes, PredictOutputBytesAsync and PreviewPlanTotals.Complete (limits, summary, fingerprint). PlanExecutionWorkflow.ExecuteAsync opens a progress overlay that cannot be canceled. The executor writes the lock and the sentinel, runs the items in order, writes the manifest and releases the lock. Progress is the weight of the completed items over the total weight. Item Segment action Weight FsCreateDirItem fs_create_dir 1 FsCopyItem, CadCopyItem fs_copy, cad_copy 3 CadRepathItem cad_repath 2 CadBindAllItem cad_bind_all 4 RevitRepathItem revit_repath 2 UIWarnItem, UIInfoItem ui_warn, ui_info 0 Each item record in Features/Domain/ passes its PlanAction and weight to PlanItem and builds its ToFingerprintSegment text. An added item type needs a case in ExecutionPlanExecutor.ExecutePlanItemAsync, which throws for an unknown item, and in ValidatePreconditions for its output paths. The fingerprint is the SHA-256 of the segments in plan order, cut to 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters. It identifies the plan in the lock and the manifest. Core Console CoreConsoleRunner writes <stem>.scr, <stem>.input.txt and <stem>.result.json in the temporary folder. The .scr file holds the script lines and then one call of an entry function. It does not load the script, because SECURELOAD refuses a file from the temporary folder. After accoreconsole.exe exits, the runner stops the Autodesk helper processes that remain in its process tree. accoreconsole.exe /i "<dwg>" /s "<stem>.scr" rs-list-xrefs result: xrefs (name, path, found, overlay, inserted, inblock) rs-repath-xrefs input: name, stored path, new path; result: changed, unmatched, failed rs-bind-all-xrefs input as above, argument BIND or INSERT; result adds bound, unbound The script writes its result with (open result "w" "utf8"), which needs the Unicode AutoLISP engine (LISPSYS 1 or 2). DATA Item Value Settings None. Names and CAD options live in the view model. Limits PlanningLimits: 80 GiB of copies, 10,000 items, and the fallback folder names Lock .recordset.lock, with the lines run_id=<run id> and fingerprint=<fingerprint> Manifest _recordset_manifests/<run id>.json: run_id, fingerprint, target_root, utc, summary (hosts, unique_links, copy_bytes, predicted_output_bytes, items) and status Run ID UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss and 4 random hexadecimal characters Link types RevitLink is Rvt, CADLink is Dwg, all others are Other, in DetermineLinkTypeOrThrow DIAGNOSTICS Log lines start with [RecordSet]. A Revit failure reads Revit operation '<operation>' failed for host '<path>': <reason>. A Core Console failure names the function, the DWG, the exit code, the result text, standard error and standard output, each cut to its last 2,000 characters. TESTS ./test.sh test --tool RecordSet # pure: dbtools.RecordSet.Pure.Tests ./test.sh test --tool RecordSet --scope local -y 2026 # -y 2027 for Revit 2027 ./test.sh test --tool RecordSet --fixture CadLiveTests # dbtools.RecordSet.Cad.Pure.Tests Pure tests cover planning, the policy, execution, the file system, the CAD adapters with a fake accoreconsole.exe .cmd file, and the view models. CadLiveTests is in its own project in the pure scope, so the default run skips it. It runs rs_xrefs.lsp in a real Core Console on generated drawings, and it is ignored unless ACCORECONSOLE names an existing file. Local tests cover composition, the view model in Revit and TransmissionDataAdapterTests, which opens sgt_test_model.rvt and its linked model (Model paths). SEE ALSO Revit Execution, Architecture overview

developer-guide/tools/experimental/vtc-s.title: View Template Comparer (VTC) specification | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/experimental/vtc-s.summary: View Template Comparer (VTC) specification This page defines the VTC snapshot, comparison, apply, copy and library contracts. The developer guide describes the implementation. Scope and tabs VTC compares view templates in the open document. It applies selected differences, stages category edits until Process, creates merged templates and stores snapshots in the local library. The tree follows the Visibility/Graphics dialog. SettingTab contains ModelCategories, AnnotationCategories, AnalyticalModelCategories, ImportedCategories, Filters, RevitLinks and Worksets. It has no Design Options tab because the public API exposes document options, not per-template option visibility. CategoryTabClassifier sends model categories with positive IDs, such as DWG and SAT imports, to ImportedCategories. Internal categories that the Visibility/Graphics dialog does not show use ModelCategories. Other category types retain their native tabs. Imported parents, layers and subcategories follow the same category compare, edit, preview, apply, merge and snapshot paths as other categories. Imported layers and subcategories use the imported parent's tab. Snapshot data TemplateSnapshot requires Name, Display, Includes, Categories, Filters, RevitLinks and Worksets. Other snapshot members are optional. A missing optional member means that the snapshot did not capture that value. Member Data SourceDocumentGuid Revit's host-document creation GUID. VTC uses matching GUIDs for project-local IDs. It does not identify a linked document. FilterOrder Ordered filter IDs and names. TemplateIncludeData.SpecId and SharedParameterGuid Parameter identity used to verify a cross-project match. TemplateIncludeData.Value A writable number, whole number, text or ElementId value, captured only for included parameters that are not owned by a display row. TemplateIncludeData.ParameterValueData.CategoryParentName Parent category name for a category-valued parameter. FilterGraphicsData.IsEnabled Filter enabled state. Pattern names and FillPatternTarget Names and kinds for line and fill pattern references. ViewDisplayModelData.SilhouetteEdgesGraphicsStyleType and SilhouetteEdgesStyleCategoryName Graphics style kind and category for silhouette mapping. RevitLinkSettingValue.ElementViewType View type for a linked-view setting. WorksetOverride.Kind Workset kind used with its name to match project-local worksets. DisplaySettingData optional members Category-kind visibility, View Display Model, background, depth cueing, sketchy lines, shadow and sunlight intensity, plan view range, color-fill schemes, point-cloud overrides and coordination-model overrides. VTC captures Detail Level, Display Style and Discipline only when the matching View.Has... method returns true. VTC does not capture extended display members for schedule, legend or drafting views. A null optional member means that the snapshot did not capture that setting. VTC captures a parameter value only when the parameter is writable, included and has a value. A captured value also requires a captured data spec. Revit compares ForgeTypeId values without the version suffix, and VTC uses the same comparison. A shared parameter with captured identity matches by GUID and spec. Other parameters with captured identity match by unique name and spec. A legacy parameter row without identity data maps by unique name and applies only its inclusion flag. VTC stores an ElementId value's name and type when available. Category values also store the parent category name when available. Built-in and sentinel IDs can remain negative IDs. Some built-in parameters return an empty ForgeTypeId. The library preserves that empty spec and requires the same spec on the target. Identity and comparison For project-local ElementId references, VTC uses an ID when the source and target are the same document and the element kind matches. Across documents, VTC maps by unique name and kind. Fill patterns use FillPatternTarget. Worksets use name and workset kind. Linked views use name and ViewType. A missing or ambiguous required match is a row conflict. The negative Solid line-pattern ID maps to Solid. A positive pattern ID without a name means that reference was not captured, so VTC keeps the target value. VTC does not substitute another named element. Silhouettes use the captured graphics style kind and category for name mapping. Older snapshots without a silhouette category map names within Lines. Revit determines whether the resolved graphics style is valid for the target view. Template parameter resolution searches only View.GetTemplateParameterIds(). A shared parameter with a captured GUID matches by GUID. Other parameters match by unique name. VTC checks every captured data spec and shared GUID, using Revit's version-insensitive ForgeTypeId equality. A value write occurs only when the selected side includes the parameter and captures a value. Parameter rows always apply the inclusion flag. VTC writes a captured parameter value only when the selected side includes the parameter and the snapshot contains its data spec and value. A null value or missing optional identity data does not capture a writable value. Filter order compares the ordered filter names. The target's filter set must equal the selected order's set before VTC changes precedence. Two comparison rows with the same key are conflicts for both rows. VTC does not select the first row silently. Revit-link settings TemplateSnapshot.RevitLinks contains one row per link type or instance and supported setting. The row key uses target kind, link name and setting kind. Link names must be unique within a target kind. VTC supports Visibility Mode, Linked View, Filters, Nested Links, Object Styles, Color Fill, View Range, Phase, Phase Filter, Detail Level and Discipline in Revit 2026 and 2027. Revit 2027 also exposes Line Weights. The 2026 extractor omits that setting. RevitLinkDiffEvaluator keys each row as link.{type|instance}.name.{LinkName}.{SettingKind}, for example link.type.name.ARCH_Model.rvt.LinkVisibilityType. A link ID is used only for a matching same-document link of the same target kind. Across documents, the link name and target kind must resolve uniquely. Duplicate names within one target kind are refused with Revit link key '<key>' is ambiguous. Link names must resolve uniquely per target kind and setting. Linked views use their saved view type. VTC refuses an ambiguous linked-view name and type. Link setting values use the fields and ranges in this table. Revit 2027 Line Weights accepts only modes 0 or 1. VTC reads and writes supported link settings through View.GetLinkOverrides and View.SetLinkOverrides. It does not copy the complete V/G Overrides RVT Links template-parameter group. Setting Valid saved values Link Visibility Type, Filters, Nested Links, Object Styles, Color Fill, View Range, Phase and Phase Filter ModeValue is 0 (By Host View), 1 (By Link View) or 2 (Custom). EnumValue is null. Linked View ElementIdValue, ElementName and ElementViewType are optional. ModeValue and EnumValue are null. A captured ElementViewType must name a defined ViewType. View Detail Level ModeValue is 0, 1 or 2. EnumValue is 0 through 3. Discipline ModeValue is 0, 1 or 2. EnumValue is Architectural (1), Structural (2), Mechanical (4), Electrical (8), Plumbing (16) or Coordination (4095). Line Weights Revit 2027 only. ModeValue is 0 or 1. EnumValue is null. Phase and Phase Filter also store optional ElementIdValue and ElementName values. VTC parses a captured linked-view type as a defined ViewType before mapping the saved view. Before it applies a Custom dependent link setting, VTC sets the link visibility mode to Custom. Line Weights accepts By Host View or By Link View. When that value differs from the current visibility mode, VTC sets the visibility mode to Custom. Apply and copy VTC applies each selected row in its own subtransaction and reads the setting back through the public Revit API. A mismatch rolls back that row and returns a conflict. For a category with unsupported visibility, VTC keeps any successful graphics write and flags the row as a conflict. An unexpected failure rolls back the batch. Library Load and Create Merged write only rows that differ from the target template. They report expected conflicts per row. They also validate saved linked-view names and types when the displayed values compare equal. A missing or ambiguous linked-view match is a row conflict. Missing optional snapshot members are skipped. For template parameters, a missing value skips the value write while the inclusion flag still applies. A filter row absent on the selected side removes that filter. A template-parameter row absent on the selected side excludes that parameter. A display value unsupported by the target view type produces a row conflict. For a link present on both sides, VTC skips a Line Weights row captured on only one side. Filter rows apply before Filter Order. VTC refuses Filter Order if the target and selected filter sets differ. Otherwise it removes and re-adds filters in source order, restores each filter's visibility, graphic overrides and enabled state, and reads back the order by source names. Category rows absent on the selected side reset target visibility and graphic overrides. Workset and Revit-link rows absent on the selected side reset only the selected setting to its host default. Missing optional display values do not reset the target. The Revit-link modal applies selected settings in one VTC Process Apply transaction with one subtransaction per setting. A missing comparison key is an ElementNotFound conflict. An unexpected fault rolls back the batch. The context menu of a concrete Revit-link group or leaf row, not the Revit Links root, provides Open Revit Link Settings... and Copy Revit Link Settings To.... Opening the modal from a leaf shows all supported settings for that target. A successful modal apply refreshes the main comparison. The modal and copy command use one template side. RevitLinkActionSourceResolver selects the only side with a value or a viable selected side. When both sides are possible, App asks which template to use. It does not default to Left. Copy writes all supported settings to each target in a separate transaction inside one Copy Revit Link Settings transaction group. Expected failures skip only that target. An unexpected fault rolls back all copied targets. Linked View maps by name and view type. Phase and Phase Filter map by name. If the source link is unloaded, VTC reuses a raw ID only when source and target refer to the same linked model. Otherwise copy fails. Library storage TemplateStorage stores saved templates as JSON in the VTC cache directory returned by AppPaths.GetToolCacheDir("VTC"), normally %APPDATA%\dbtools\Cache\VTC\. TemplateStorage alone derives file paths. Callers use logical template names. Rooted names and names containing path separators are rejected. SavedTemplateInfo exposes only the name and modification time. Required top-level members and nested values are validated on save and load. Optional members may be absent. Null entries, invalid enums and malformed nested collections are rejected with TemplateStorageException. VTC does not normalize or repair incompatible files. GetSavedTemplates returns an empty list when the cache directory does not exist and does not create it. Other enumeration errors raise TemplateStorageException with operation enumerate. TemplateExists returns false for a missing file or directory. Other probe errors raise TemplateStorageException with operation probe, so saving does not overwrite an unverified path. Only SaveTemplate creates the directory. Replacing an existing name requires the user's Replace choice. Without replacement, atomic creation keeps a file saved concurrently by another process and reports a storage error. MergedTemplateBuilder writes RevitLinks rows like other diff rows. Link rows participate in Preview, Process, Create Merged and merged save. Testing See VTC testing for Pure and Revit-hosted fixture inventories. Limitations VTC compares templates in one open document. The library stores snapshots for use in another project. The public API path does not expose the complete Revit-link Custom-tab category tables, link Visible, Halftone and Underlay values, per-template Design Option visibility, shadow on/off, ambient shadows, lighting scheme, exposure or coordination-model reference-level overrides. Revit exposes no public setter for a background of type None. VTC extracts and compares that value but refuses to apply it. The hosted ApplyViewTemplateParameters probe covers basic link visibility type and linked-view settings. It does not establish that custom per-category tables are copied, and VTC does not use that whole-tab route. Library Load requires a saved name and kind to map linked elements. A row without that identity is refused. Copy can reuse an ID only when both link targets reference the same linked model; otherwise copy fails.

developer-guide/tools/experimental/vtc.h.title: View Template Comparer (VTC) | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/experimental/vtc.h.summary: View Template Comparer (VTC) Overview View Template Comparer (VTC) compares two Revit view templates of the current document, stages category edits locally, and applies the selected differences and eligible pending overrides through one command, ApplySelectedChangesCommand (button label "Process"). It can also create a merged template and save templates to a local library. The data contract (tabs, imported categories, Revit-link settings, keys, apply and copy rules, library storage) is in the VTC specification. Architecture Source: src/Tools/Experimental/VTC/. The manifest registers dbtools.VTC on the Testing ribbon panel with InlineUi, order 50, and icon key vtc. Command and composition ToolCommand opens the Revit API scope. VtcCommand calls VtcWindowLauncher and keeps the modal window inside that scope. Writes use the command's inline transaction runner. VtcWindowLauncher owns the modal launch: it resolves the document's templates, shows an alert when there are none, has VtcWindowCompositionFactory build the collaborators, and creates VtcWindowSession through Core's ToolWindowFactory. After the dialog closes it opens the logger window when Debug Mode is on. It always retires the comparer and linked-file windows; a dialog failure is reported before any retirement failure. VtcWindowCompositionFactory creates one graph per document: TemplateExtractor, RevitLinkSettingsAdapter, TemplateDifferenceEvaluator, TemplateApplier, TemplateMaterializer, TemplateStorage (cache directory AppPaths.GetToolCacheDir("VTC")) and the one document facade, TemplateRuntime. TemplateRuntime (Revit/Template) resolves template IDs and exposes compare, extract, batch apply, create merged, apply model, Revit-link targets and copy, and line and fill pattern queries. App batch-session code depends on the App/Sessions/ITemplateSessionRuntime port, which TemplateRuntime implements. VtcWindowSession owns the modal window session. ToolWindowFactory supplies the stable shell for the raw VTC view. Comparison owns the workspace, Inspector and Preview views; Library owns its workspace view; the Revit-link modal reuses the Comparison diff control. AlertPresenter is the only alert boundary in App. Composition gives the alert service only to the presenter; view models and workflows use the presenter for standard alerts, custom requests and selections. VtcWindowBatchWorkflow handles App session reactions for Process and Library work. The App view model owns Revit-link prompts, modal hosting, refresh and result presentation. TemplateRuntime passes Revit-link batch apply and copy, and the classification of expected conflicts, to Template Apply. VtcWindowCommandRuntime reports a refused operation through SafeExecutionRefusalReporter as VTC {operation}. Sources: src/Tools/Experimental/VTC/Revit/Template/TemplateRuntime.cs, src/Tools/Experimental/VTC/Features/TemplateApply/Execution/TemplateApplier.Operations.cs, src/Tools/Experimental/VTC/App/Composition/VtcWindowCompositionFactory.cs. Source layout VTC has several features under Features/, each with its own domain, planning, state, Revit and UI code: Path Content Features/Comparison Diff tree (DiffTreeBuilder, DiffTreeIndex, DiffTreeNode, DiffTreeProjector), preview projection, window comparison state (VtcWindowComparisonCoordinator), category tab classification and RevitLinkActionSourceResolver Features/Library TemplateStorage, SavedTemplateInfo, TemplateStorageException Features/RevitLinks RevitLinkDiffEvaluator, RevitLinkSettingsAdapter, RevitLinkTargetResolver, the Revit-link settings window Features/TemplateApply TemplateApplier partials, pending overrides (PendingOverrideState), apply results and conflicts, MergedTemplateBuilder, SnapshotSelectionPolicy, pattern rendering and override editors Features/TemplateComparison.cs, Features/TemplateDifferenceEvaluator.cs Host-neutral comparison result and evaluator Domain/ Tool-wide vocabulary: TemplateSnapshot, SettingDifference, SettingValue, SettingTab, RevitLinkSetting, RevitLinkSettingKind, RevitLinkSettingValue, RevitLinkTarget, RevitLinkTargetKind and the graphics data types Revit/Template TemplateExtractor, TemplateMaterializer, TemplateRuntime App/ Composition, sessions, view models, views and design-time data TemplateDifferenceEvaluator is host-neutral. TemplateExtractor and RevitLinkSettingsAdapter own the Revit mechanics behind TemplateRuntime. SettingDifference.LeftValue and RightValue hold typed SettingValue cases. Compare, apply and App code pattern-match these cases. Display settings use VTC enums (DetailLevelKind, DisplayStyleKind, PartsVisibilityMode, ViewDisciplineKind, ShowHiddenLinesMode); conversion to Revit enums happens only at the Revit API boundary. SettingPreviewItem and DiffTreeProjector.ViewFilter are Comparison contracts, so feature projections do not import App view models. DiffTreeNode holds comparison and display state only. PendingOverrideState holds pending override DTOs with no tree or UI dependency. TemplateApplyResult is the only apply outcome; the App view model (TemplateApplyOutcomeProjection) projects it onto setting keys for row feedback and filters and stores no outcome on comparison nodes. DiffTreeBuilder only builds a tree from differences. DiffTreeIndex keeps the rebuilt roots and owns key lookup, canonical node paths, selection collection in tree order and Revit-link subtree queries for the coordinator, the preview projection and the Revit-link modal. MergedTemplateBuilder (Features/TemplateApply/Planning/MergedTemplate) builds the merged TemplateSnapshot from the comparison result, the selections, the base side and the name. View-model operations only orchestrate effects. App composes outcome templates into Comparison views at runtime; Comparison raises only selected-node, override-edit and preview-setting requests for App to coordinate across panes and modals. Views VTC views are raw XAML EmbeddedResource items with explicit logical names: dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.VtcWindow.xaml (main view) dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.AlertBodyTemplates.xaml dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.ComparisonWorkspaceView.xaml dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.ComparisonInspectorView.xaml dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.ComparisonPreviewView.xaml dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.DiffViewControl.xaml dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.LibraryView.xaml dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.RevitLinkSettingsWindow.xaml VtcWindowSession loads the main resource through ToolWindowFactory and owns the one-time owner attachment and cleanup. VTC has no custom close gate and no native pick loop. Shared resource dictionaries are in dbtools.Presentation/Tools/VTC/: VtcDiffViewStyles.xaml and VtcComparisonViewStyles.xaml. The namespace dbtools.Presentation.Tools.VTC holds the converters VtcConflictConverter and VtcRawViewConverter. VtcResourceTemplateSelector resolves App outcome templates and returns an empty template in a standalone view. Alert bodies use full type-name string keys with TypeNameTemplateSelector. Every content and item slot has an explicit template; immutable record values bind OneTime and mutable view-model state uses INotifyPropertyChanged. Each raw view merges Theme once, before the VTC dictionaries; the shared dictionaries do not merge Theme. Vtc.TreeView is based on the implicit TreeView style with VTC overrides; each tree sets its own scrolling and virtualization. Named item selectors set TextSearch.TextPath for prefix typing and automation names on their template text. SavedTemplateInfo, ViewFilterOption, LinePatternData, FillPatternData and TemplateOption return their display label from ToString(), so automation peers and text fallbacks show the label. Preview navigation is available only for navigable setting keys. Double-click override editing responds to the left mouse button only, on eligible rows. Keyboard focus moves to the comparison row after the Inspector tab loads. Pending focus and close requests are canceled on retirement. The linked dialog's context-menu selection commands bind to its own view model. The raw linked view has the automation name "Linked file override differences". The main window initializer uses the log prefix VtcWindow. Data and contracts The specification defines setting keys, typed values, name mapping, library compatibility and API limits. The extractor records the source document GUID, included writable template-parameter values with their spec and shared GUID, filter enabled state and order, category-kind visibility, view display settings, view range, color-fill schemes, point-cloud overrides and coordination-model overrides. The library accepts snapshots that omit optional members. The evaluator compares project-local references by name and kind when IDs differ. Workflows Process and merged templates ApplySelectedChangesCommand applies the selections and eligible pending category overrides in one VTC Process Apply transaction, with one SubTransaction per setting so an expected conflict rolls back only that setting. Each setting write reads the value back through the public Revit API. A mismatch rolls back that setting and becomes a per-setting conflict. Template parameter application resolves parameters only among GetTemplateParameterIds(). It checks captured data specs and shared GUIDs, and writes a value only when the selected side includes the parameter and the snapshot contains the value. Revit's ForgeTypeId equality ignores the version suffix. Project-local ElementId values, view-range levels, color-fill schemes, line styles, fill patterns, point clouds, coordination models and worksets use a same-document ID of the expected kind or a unique name and kind match across documents. Linked views map by name and ViewType. A missing, ambiguous or incompatible match is refused. Snapshot Load and Create Merged apply only rows that differ from the target. A missing optional member is skipped; a missing parameter value still applies the inclusion flag. Expected failures are reported per row. Two rows with the same comparison key both conflict. Saved linked-view rows also resolve by name and ViewType when their displayed values compare equal. An ambiguous or missing reference becomes a per-row conflict without a write. Filter-order application runs after all filter rows. It refuses unless the target filter set matches the selected order, then removes and re-adds filters in source order, restores each filter's visibility, graphic overrides and enabled state, and checks the result against source filter names. The adapter uses RevitLinkGraphicsSettings.LineWeights under REVIT2027_OR_GREATER from Directory.Build.targets. The Revit 2026 extractor omits Line Weights. Category application checks CanCategoryBeHidden and IsCategoryOverridable before writing. If only the requested visibility is unsupported, VTC keeps the graphics write and reports an IncompatibleValue conflict. Unsupported graphics that already match need no write. If the graphics differ, VTC rolls back the row and returns a ReadOnlyParameter conflict. An apply failure becomes a per-setting conflict only after its sub-transaction confirms RolledBack. If the rollback throws or reports another status, the batch stops with a BatchApplyException that contains the apply failure and then the rollback failure. An unconfirmed rollback never publishes a pending-override conflict key. Create Merged (TemplateRuntime.CreateMergedTemplate) runs template creation and the pending-override batch in one transaction group, Create Merged View Template, started through RevitTransactionGroups.Begin and assimilated into one Undo entry. Expected per-setting conflicts are reported and the new template is kept. Any other fault rolls the group back and leaves no template, so a retry with the same name works. TemplateMaterializer copies the Left template with ElementTransformUtils.CopyElements and a duplicate-type handler that keeps destination types, so Revit shows no dialog. It catches no copy failure: a fault rolls back the group and reaches RunOrReport as an Error alert. Library Load owns its transaction and refuses a document with an open transaction. After apply, the view model rebuilds the comparison. If that fails, the result alert includes the apply counts, conflicts and refresh error. VtcWindowBatchWorkflow.SavedTemplates treats template extraction or merge and the cache save or delete as the change. After that change, the list refresh has its own error boundary: a refresh failure is logged with the template name and shows one warning that the cache operation succeeded; success is shown only after the refresh succeeds. Both save commands ask Replace saved template 'X'? through AlertPresenter before they overwrite an existing name; Cancel writes nothing. Testing dbtools.VTC.Pure.Tests (no Revit host): DiffTreeBuilderTests, DiffTreeIndexTests, DiffTreeNode*Tests, DiffTreeProjectorTests: grouping, selection state and change notification, including imported-category tabs and Revit-link grouping by link name. PendingOverrideStateTests, PendingCategoryOverrideTests: staging, eligibility, restore, clear, merge-save application and failed-pending collection. TemplateApplyOutcomeProjectionTests: keyed conflict and success projection for row feedback and result filters. TemplateStorageTests: the real storage service with a temporary cache directory, including previous-version JSON, every optional member and malformed values. The project references the VTC product assembly directly, not dbtools.App. TemplateDiffEvaluatorTests, RevitLinkDiffEvaluatorTests, SnapshotSelectionPolicyTests: snapshot comparison, duplicate-key handling and snapshot row selection. TemplateElementNameMappingPolicyTests: unique, missing and ambiguous project-local name mapping. RevitLinkActionSourceResolverTests: sole-side, selected-side, ambiguous-side and no-value resolution. AlertBodyTemplateProviderTests: the provider and its raw dbtools.ToolViews.VTC.AlertBodyTemplates.xaml resource (WPF only). VtcRawXamlParseTests: the linked-file view's accessible name and its view model passed to the composed diff view. Raw comparison view tests use the registered ToolWindowFactory session and the stable behavior bindings. Revit-hosted tests (the local scope) in dbtools.VTC.Local.Tests use the Global Mapper (GM) and Super Girt Tool (SGT) test models. RevitTestBase enters through RevitHost, uses the inline call gate and rolls back test changes through TransactionGroupService in the same callback. VtcWindowViewModelHostedTests: Process, Create Merged, Library, Revit-link actions and window lifecycle. VtcCompositionContractsTests: VTC service registration, composition and launch, including failure precedence during retirement. RevitLinkBaselineTests: extract and apply round trips of LinkVisibilityType and LinkedViewId on RevitLinkType and RevitLinkInstance targets in sgt_test_model.rvt. RevitLinkExtendedTests: the other RevitLinkGraphicsSettings members on the SGT linked model. RevitLinkSnapshotRemapTests: snapshot compare and apply with colliding link IDs, LinkName pairing, and linked-element name and view-type remapping. ImportedCategoryRoundTripTests: imports a shared CAD file inside the rollback scope and checks that imported categories use the normal category compare and apply path. TemplateApplierSettingsTests: view display settings, per-row unsupported-view conflicts, view range, filter-order set validation and state restoration, template-parameter values and identity, ForgeTypeId equality, and color-fill schemes. TemplateApplierCategoryTests: category visibility and graphics writes, including partial success when visibility is read-only. TemplateApplierBatchTests: batch selection, missing-key conflicts, unexpected-fault rollback and retry after a failed Create Merged attempt. TemplateApplierOperationsTests: snapshot Load, legacy-shaped library JSON with uncaptured values, duplicate-key conflicts, and Create Merged on a 3D template. RevitLinkSettingsAdapterValuesTests: link setting read-back, including 2027 Line Weights and the 2026 unavailable label. LinkedFileVisibilityTabProbeTests: checks that ApplyViewTemplateParameters copies basic link visibility type and linked-view settings to a template without changing other template parameters. It does not probe linked per-category tables or implement whole-tab copying in VTC. TemplateExtractorExtractionTests: extraction from the GM model and from created schedule and drafting templates. TemplateExtractorResolutionTests, TemplateExtractorGraphicsTests: project-local category, parameter, element, pattern and silhouette line-style mapping, including Solid. SgtModelExtractionTests, GmModelExtractionTests: extraction from existing views and presence of link targets in the open models. Limitations Comparison requires two view templates in the same document. VTC applies supported Revit-link settings individually and does not copy the complete V/G Overrides RVT Links template-parameter group. The public API has no setter for a None view background and does not enumerate coordination-model reference-level overrides. Link Custom-tab tables, link Visible/Halftone/Underlay values, design-option visibility, shadow on/off, ambient shadows, lighting scheme and exposure are not handled. Other Revit-link settings are limited to public API members; linked-element remapping follows the rules in the specification.

developer-guide/tools/services/dialog-su.title: dbtools.DialogSuppression | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/services/dialog-su.summary: dbtools.DialogSuppression NAME dbtools.DialogSuppression - match Revit dialog text against configured rules SYNOPSIS source src/Tools/Services/DialogSuppression/ (manifest.yml) assembly dbtools.DialogSuppression entry DialogSuppressionToolModule hook DialogSuppressionHook DESCRIPTION DialogSuppressionToolModule registers a lifecycle hook and the Dialog Suppression settings pack. The pack is the user entry point for the service. DialogSuppressionToolModuleTests checks both registrations and the singleton adapter registration. STRUCTURE Path under the tool source Owner Features/DialogSuppressionHook.cs InitializeAsync, RollbackAsync and Shutdown. Features/DialogBoxShowing/ DialogBoxShowingEventAdapter.Subscribe and Unsubscribe. Features/DialogSuppressionPolicy.cs DialogSuppressionPolicy reads settings, matches the dialog text and requests an override. Settings/ DialogSuppressionSettingsContext validates the edits from DialogSuppressionSettingsView.xaml and builds the options snapshot. The adapter looks up DialogBoxShowing and builds its delegate with reflection. Its handler takes the event arguments as object. See the comment on DialogBoxShowingEventAdapter.OnDialogBoxShowing for the Revit event-argument type rationale. CONTRACTS DialogSuppressionPolicy.Apply reads the Services flag for each event. An override requires both SettingsFlags.ServicesModeEnabled and DialogSuppressionSettings.Enabled. DialogSuppressionPolicyTests checks the Services flag and changes to the patterns between events. The policy creates regular expressions with RegexOptions.IgnoreCase. It reuses them while the resolved pattern sequence stays the same. It divides 250 ms among those patterns, with a minimum of 1 ms per pattern. DialogSuppressionPolicyTests checks matching, cache invalidation and timeout handling. DialogSuppressionSettingsContext blocks saves with an invalid regular expression or an empty list of nonblank patterns. DialogSuppressionSettingsContextTests checks save validation. FLOW DialogSuppressionPolicy.GetDialogMessage reads the first non-null string in Message, MainInstruction and Title, in that order. On the first match, the policy calls OverrideResult(1) if the event arguments expose that method. DialogSuppressionPolicyTests checks the value with test event arguments. DATA The services.dialog_suppression pack uses Tools.DialogSuppression. Enabled and SuppressInternalExceptions default to true. SuppressInternalExceptions persists with the pack and has no effect on suppression. The view exposes Enable Dialog Suppression and Dialog text patterns. The policy uses DefaultSuppressedDialogPatterns when the saved list contains no nonblank patterns. Otherwise, it considers the full nonblank list. The editor binds to DialogSuppressionSettingsContext.PatternList. It loads the first three nonblank patterns and displays the default if there are none. Saving Settings writes the editor snapshot. It omits blank rows, saves a sole default as an empty list, and preserves other pattern text as entered. AppPaths.GetSettingsFile defines the path for each Revit year. DIAGNOSTICS DialogSuppressionPolicy logs invalid patterns and match timeouts as warnings. It tries a timed-out pattern on later events and logs its timeout once per pattern text. DialogSuppressionHook logs handler failures under DialogSuppression handler failed. TESTS ./test.sh test --tool DialogSuppression --scope pure ./test.sh test --tool DialogSuppression --scope local -y 2026 DialogSuppressionSettingsTests checks the round trip of Enabled, SuppressInternalExceptions and SuppressedDialogPatterns. DialogSuppressionSettingsViewTests checks the view, its data context, and the pattern list bindings. DialogSuppressionHookErrorBoundaryTests invokes DialogSuppressionHook.OnDialogBoxShowing by reflection with test event arguments. It checks that the handler logs an override failure and returns. SEE ALSO Hooks, Settings Packs, Getting Started

developer-guide/tools/structural/analyti.title: dbtools.AnalyticalSnapToLevel | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/structural/analyti.summary: dbtools.AnalyticalSnapToLevel NAME dbtools.AnalyticalSnapToLevel - snap analytical members to a level SYNOPSIS source src/Tools/Structural/AnalyticalSnapToLevel/ (manifest.yml) assembly dbtools.AnalyticalSnapToLevel entry AnalyticalSnapToLevelCommand DESCRIPTION AnalyticalSnapToLevelWorkflow reads the selection and prompts for a target Level. It passes both to AnalyticalSnapper. See Analytical Snap To Level. STRUCTURE File Owner App/Composition/AnalyticalSnapToLevelCommand.cs CommandAvailability.HasSelection gates the command. [CommandService] declares the workflow for App to register. Features/AnalyticalSnapToLevelWorkflow.cs The workflow owns the level choices and the completion alert. Features/AnalyticalSnapper.cs Run checks selected elements and writes Revit curves. Features/AnalyticalSegment.cs SnapTo computes endpoint coordinates on plain values. CONTRACTS SnapTo sets both endpoint Z values for a Beam. For a Column, it changes the Z of the nearer endpoint, using the start on a tie. It preserves X and Y. AnalyticalSegmentTests and AnalyticalSegmentEdgeCaseTests check the endpoint rules. See AnalyticalSnapper.Run and TryResolveRole for member and role checks. AnalyticalSnapperRevitTests.Run_SkipsTransientArcBeamAndKeepsItsArc checks the arc skip. AnalyticalSnapToLevelWorkflowTests.Execute_MixedSelection_ListsSkippedMembersByReason checks the reported not straight and would collapse reasons. AnalyticalSnapToLevelWorkflowTests checks that Execute refuses an empty selection or a cancelled level picker before calling the snapper. FLOW PickTargetLevel owns the IAlertService.SelectSingle request. AnalyticalSnapper.Run owns the transaction and curve writes. See BuildAdjustedCurve for the short-curve check. Execute builds the completion alert from the processed count and the skip reasons. The grouping and ID limits live in AnalyticalSnapToLevelWorkflow.cs. After the alert, Execute calls EnsureWindowIfDebugMode. AnalyticalSnapToLevelWorkflowTests.Execute_HappyPath_SnapsSelectionShowsSummaryAndEnsuresLoggerWindow checks the alert request and the logger call. DIAGNOSTICS Debug messages with the prefix [AnalyticalSnap] give the target level, the result for each element and the totals. TESTS ./test.sh test --tool AnalyticalSnapToLevel --scope pure ./test.sh test --tool AnalyticalSnapToLevel --scope local -y 2026 AnalyticalSnapToLevelCommandTests checks the command attributes. The snapper and workflow fixtures create temporary analytical members in gm_test_model.rvt. See Model paths. SEE ALSO dbtools.FramingJoins, Revit Execution and Progress Overlay

developer-guide/tools/structural/foundat.title: dbtools.FoundationTags | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/structural/foundat.summary: dbtools.FoundationTags NAME dbtools.FoundationTags - update foundation tag data and move tag heads SYNOPSIS source src/Tools/Structural/FoundationTags/ (manifest.yml) assembly dbtools.FoundationTags entry FoundationTagsToolModule commands UpdateCombinedFoundationTagsCommand, MoveCombinedFoundationTagsCommand view src/dbtools.Presentation/Tools/FoundationTags/FoundationTagsSettingsPackView.xaml DESCRIPTION See Combined Foundation Tags for command usage. STRUCTURE Path Owner App/Composition/ AddFoundationTags registers workflows, PrerequisiteRepairOffer, and view-activation tasks. Features/ CombinedFoundationTagsUpdater writes parameters. FamilyNameClassifier uses FoundationTagPatterns to compile patterns. Features/AutoUpdate/ CombinedFoundationTagsAutoUpdateTask owns automatic updates. Features/Move/ MoveCombinedFoundationTagsRunner moves tag heads. Features/Prerequisite/ PrerequisiteSharedParameterInstaller checks and repairs bindings. Settings/ SettingsPackContext.WarningFix.cs owns both Install/Repair routes. The pack view calls LoadRequiredParametersCommand on Loaded. CONTRACTS Both commands call PrerequisiteRepairOffer.EnsureReady before their workflows. It refuses a family document with SafeExecutionRefusedException and the message <command> works in a project. The active document is a family. It propagates that exception from a dead binding key. It converts a repair InvalidOperationException to SafeExecutionRefusedException and keeps the warning active. Successful Repair clears the warning and asks for a rerun. FoundationTagsFeatureOwnerTests checks these paths. The manifest warning points to Settings > Combined Foundation Tags > Install/Repair. The pack button calls InstallOrRepairRequiredParametersCommand. The warning card calls FixWarningAsync. FixLabel supplies Install/Repair. Both paths use RunInstallOrRepairRequiredParameters. SettingsPackContextWarningFixTests checks pack-button repair and refusal from the warning card without an active document. SettingsPackContextScheduleUseTests checks Cancel on both routes. UpdateParameterWriter skips changes to non-varying parameters in repeated groups. CombinedTagsTests.Run_GroupPlacements_SkipRestrictedMembersAndWriteOthers checks that footings can use the computed pier top after that skip. Run_InvalidPierTop_DoesNotReuseStoredTopForFooting checks the mark and stored footing elevation when Top Level is unconnected. Run_WithNoPierWithinThreshold_ClearsElevationOrReportsRefusal checks both bindings of Associated Pier Elevation. When no pier is in range, TryClearDouble calls SharedParameterValue.Clear and checks HasValue. RecordParameterWrite logs clear refusals with the element ID and parameter name. The updater shares one ten-entry warning limit across pier, footing and repeated-group details. RequireSourceUIDocument limits result selection to the source document (FoundationTagsFeatureOwnerTests). FLOW PublishSelectionSets calls PruneSelectionSets to keep up to five dbtools - FoundationTags - sets by descending element ID. CombinedTagsTests.Run_SixRunsAtDistinctHours_PrunesTheOldestSelectionSet checks pruning. See CombinedFoundationTagsUpdater.Run for transaction order. SelectCornerByViewOrientation matches Top Right, Top Left, Bottom Right, and Bottom Left case-insensitively. TryGetTaggedFooting checks both host and loaded link references. TryGetFootingCornersInHost applies the link transform to linked corners. See GetDesiredCornerName and MoveTag for name and position handling. CombinedTagsTests.MoveCombinedTags_WithTransientTaggedFooting_ChangesTagHeadPosition checks the tag position in the active model. Both view-activation tasks use PanelScopedViewActivationTask for Structural. PrerequisiteMonitorTask checks on document changes and retries transient results on Idling. Auto-update admits floor and ceiling plans with AutoUpdateEnabled on and the warning inactive. See CombinedFoundationTagsAutoUpdateTask.ExecuteInternalAsync for execution. Prerequisites and repair EnsureInstalledAndValid asks before removing schedule fields or view filter rules. It replans project and family changes after confirmation. Repair migrates families first. It calls SharedParameterMigration with RemoveWithParameter when it replaces a project parameter. The migration formats project value failures with ElementDisplayName. Repair calls Assimilate after every status is OK. FoundationTagsScheduleFieldTests, FoundationTagsViewFilterTests, and FoundationTagsFamilyRepairTests check these paths. DATA Tools.FoundationTags stores AutoUpdateEnabled (default true), TagFamilyPatterns, PierFamilyPatterns, and FootingFamilyPatterns. Empty lists use FoundationTagsSettings defaults. FoundationTagPatterns skips invalid regexes and logs a Warning. core.structural.combined_tags in structural.foundation_tags blocks both commands and Organize Foundation Types. PrerequisiteRequiredParameters and PrerequisiteSharedParameters.txt define the shared parameters. Operation Transaction or group name Update group dbtools - Update Combined Foundation Tags Move transaction dbtools - Move Combined Foundation Tags Install/Repair group dbtools - Install/Repair Combined Foundation Tags Shared Parameters build/Distribution/tool-contracts.json holds repair alert strings checked by ToolContractsTests. DIAGNOSTICS [CombinedTags] logs update skips. [MoveCombinedTags] logs move failures. [FoundationTags/Prereqs] logs prerequisite checks. [FoundationTags/SP] logs installer activity. SettingsPackContext.LoadRequiredParameters logs failures under [FoundationTags/Settings]. TESTS ./test.sh test --tool FoundationTags --scope pure ./test.sh test --tool FoundationTags --scope local -y 2026 CombinedTagsTests uses gm_test_model.rvt. FoundationGeometryTests checks distance and corner matching. CombinedFoundationTagsAutoUpdateTaskTests checks admission. It creates two projects in the isolated profile for the native activation test. View activation sets the prerequisite warning for the project with missing bindings and clears it for the project with the required bindings. SEE ALSO Shared parameter migration, Feature Warnings, Settings Packs

developer-guide/tools/structural/framing.title: dbtools.FramingJoins | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/structural/framing.summary: dbtools.FramingJoins NAME dbtools.FramingJoins - allow or disallow joins at framing ends SYNOPSIS source src/Tools/Structural/FramingJoins/ (manifest.yml) assembly dbtools.FramingJoins entry AllowJoinSelectedCommand, DisallowJoinSelectedCommand DESCRIPTION Both commands pass a FramingJoinOperation to FramingJoinsWorkflow.ExecuteAsync. See Allow Join and Disallow Join. STRUCTURE Path Owner App/Composition/ Both commands pass Revit's selected categories to CommandAvailability.HasStructuralFramingSelection and declare the workflow with [CommandService]. Features/FramingJoinTargetBuilder.cs The builder filters plain IDs by category. Features/FramingJoinsWorkflow.cs The workflow collects the selection and owns the transaction and result banner. Features/FramingJoinsWorkflow.Core.cs ExecuteCore applies one operation to the prepared targets. CONTRACTS FramingJoinTargetBuilderTests checks category filtering. See FramingJoinsWorkflow.CollectStructuralFramingIds for ID preparation and ExecuteAsync for selection checks and target construction. ExecuteCore calls ends 0 and 1 in order. It counts a target after both calls return. FramingJoinsWorkflowTests checks the calls and the count. FramingJoinsWorkflowRevitTests checks the join state at both ends of a beam. If an end operation throws, ExecuteCore throws InvalidOperationException with the element ID and the original exception. FramingJoinsWorkflowTests checks this error. FLOW ExecuteAsync reads UIDocument.Selection and pairs each selected ID with its document category for CollectStructuralFramingIds. For selected framing family instances, it prepares JoinOperationTarget delegates for StructuralFramingUtils.AllowJoinAtEnd and DisallowJoinAtEnd. The workflow calls ExecuteCore inside one ITransactionRunner.RunInDocumentAsync call. See the NotificationBannerService.ShowToast and EnsureWindowIfDebugMode calls at the end of ExecuteAsync. DIAGNOSTICS ExecuteCore logs the operation and element ID at Error level before it throws. The prefix is [AllowJoin] or [DisallowJoin]. ToolCommand uses ISafeExecutor for command failures. See Revit Execution and Progress Overlay. TESTS ./test.sh test --tool FramingJoins --scope pure ./test.sh test --tool FramingJoins --scope local -y 2026 FramingJoinsCommandTests checks both command declarations. FramingJoinsWorkflowRevitTests needs a level and a structural framing type in gm_test_model.rvt. See Model paths. SEE ALSO dbtools.AnalyticalSnapToLevel

developer-guide/tools/structural/joist-g.title: dbtools.JoistGirderWeight | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/structural/joist-g.summary: dbtools.JoistGirderWeight NAME dbtools.JoistGirderWeight - the assembly behind Update Joist Girder Weights SYNOPSIS source src/Tools/Structural/JoistGirderWeight/ (manifest.yml) assembly dbtools.JoistGirderWeight entry JoistGirderWeightToolModule command UpdateJoistGirderWeightsCommand (run profile InlineUi) view src/Tools/Structural/JoistGirderWeight/Settings/Views/JoistGirderWeightSettingsView.xaml DESCRIPTION The ribbon command and the auto-update task both call JoistGirderWeightUpdater.UpdateAll. It estimates Wt for each girder that matches the family pattern and writes it. The four patterns are .NET regular expressions from the settings. The user page describes the behavior, and Revit Execution the Core types. STRUCTURE Paths are under src/Tools/Structural/JoistGirderWeight/. Path Contents App/Composition/ JoistGirderWeightToolModule registers the settings section and pack. ServiceCollectionExtensions registers the auto-update task and the workflow. Features/Workflow/ WeightUpdateWorkflow runs the command and shows the banner. Features/AutoUpdate/ AutoUpdateTask is the view-activation task. Features/JoistGirder/ JoistGirderWeightUpdater collects, checks and writes. JoistGirderClassifier compiles the patterns. JoistGirderWeightEvaluator holds the formula. Features/Load/ Operations/ElementLoadReader reads Force and text parameters. LoadParser parses load text. LoadResolutionEvaluator picks the total or dead plus live. Settings/ JoistGirderWeightSettings and SettingsPackContext, which holds the pack state and validation. Features/DefaultPatterns.cs holds the defaults. CONTRACTS One transaction. UpdateAll checks every candidate, then writes all valid girders in one transaction, Auto Update Joist Girder Weights. No test checks this. Bad pattern. A pattern that does not compile throws JoistGirderConfigurationException before any write. The workflow shows it in a banner. AutoUpdateTask also activates the pack warning. UpdateJoistGirderWeightsWorkflowTests and AutoUpdateTaskTests check this. Other auto-update failures. ViewActivationHook skips the task for the rest of the document session, keyed by DocumentSessionKey. Core's ViewActivationHookTests check the mechanism. Load groups. The same patterns find and classify the loads. ClassifyLoadGroup tries Dead, then Live, then Total, and throws if none matches. JoistGirderClassifierTests checks the groups but not the order. ElementLoadReader reads Double parameters with the Force spec and String parameters. It converts Force values to kips and compares spec names independent of version. LoadParser reads load text as a nonnegative number with an optional unit. The user guide lists the units. Blank Force and text inputs are unpopulated. Only populated inputs count toward ambiguity. A populated total takes precedence over the dead and live sum. Otherwise, both groups need an input and at least one group needs a value. A group with only blank inputs contributes zero. An instance input takes precedence over a same-named type input, including when the instance input is blank. Unsupported storage and invalid load text stay out of resolution. If neither load source resolves, the tool reports missing or blank loads and lists excluded matches and their reasons in the same issue. The diagnostic includes unparseable text. Empty and invalid patterns. An empty pattern means the default, in JoistGirderClassifier and SettingsPackContext.LoadCore. The context displays the defaults. It stores an empty string when the trimmed text matches the default and saves other pattern text as entered. CollectValidationErrors reports bad patterns, and the inherited BlockSaveOnInvalid makes Save refuse them. SettingsPackContextTests checks the errors, but no test checks the refusal for this pack. Admission. ViewActivationTask.AdmitAsync reads the settings once. It skips the task when auto-update is off or the pack warning is active. AutoUpdateTask runs with that copy. AutoUpdateTaskTests checks this. One warning. GetSingleWarning requires exactly one pack warning in manifest.yml. JoistGirderWeightToolModuleTests checks its ID, pack and disabled tool. FLOW The command calls WeightUpdateWorkflow.Execute, which calls JoistGirderWeightUpdater.UpdateAll. UpdateAll collects the OST_StructuralFraming instances whose family name matches. It uses the type name only when the family name is empty. TryBuildUpdate checks Wt, number of joists, load, length and depth, in that order. The first failure is the skip reason. One transaction sets Wt. Updated counts the Set calls that do not throw, and ignores their bool result. The workflow shows the summary in a banner. Auto-update runs UpdateAll through its own TransactionRunner and InlineRevitCallGate, and discards the summary. Formula JoistGirderWeightEvaluator.EstimateWeight takes feet and works in inches. Its factors are local constants, such as allowableStress (50 ksi) and connectionFactor (0.6). N Number of Joists, used as the number of equal spaces P point load, kips, at each of the N - 1 panel points L length, in D depth, in s = L / N panel spacing R = P (N - 1) / 2 end reaction M = R L / 2 - sum of P x (distance to midspan), over the panel loads between one support and midspan F = M / (0.95 D) chord force A = F / (50 ksi x 0.6) chord area top = A L x 0.28356 lb/in^3 x 1.06 top chord weight bottom = 1.13 x top web = 0.7 x top Wt = (top + bottom + web) / (L / 12), in lb/ft DATA Item Value Settings section Tools.JoistGirderWeight, read into JoistGirderWeightSettings Settings pack structural.joist_girder_weight Pack warning core.structural.joist_girder. It disables the command dbtools.UpdateJoistGirderWeights and auto-update. The startup settings check sets it for a bad saved pattern. Reads Instance and type parameters. For loads, also each document ParameterElement whose name matches a load pattern. Writes Wt only DIAGNOSTICS Log lines start with [JoistGirder]. Debug level adds the counts and the sample skips. A bad pattern logs a Warning: Update failed for document … from the command, or Auto-update disabled due to configuration: … from auto-update. TESTS ./test.sh test --tool JoistGirderWeight # pure scope, the default ./test.sh test --tool JoistGirderWeight --scope local -y 2026 # -y 2027 for Revit 2027 Pure tests cover the patterns, formula, load parsing, settings and the settings pack view factory. Local tests cover composition, the updater, the workflow, auto-update and the WPF theme resources. JoistGirderWeightSettingsViewTests lives in src/Tools/Structural/JoistGirderWeight/Tests/Integration/Revit/Settings/Views/. The Revit tests open gm_test_model.rvt (Model paths), whose Vulcraft Joist Girder instances have no usable load. Without the model, they are inconclusive. SEE ALSO Hooks, Feature Warnings, Settings Packs

developer-guide/tools/structural/organiz.title: dbtools.OrganizeFoundationTypes | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/structural/organiz.summary: dbtools.OrganizeFoundationTypes NAME dbtools.OrganizeFoundationTypes - name, mark and merge foundation types SYNOPSIS source src/Tools/Structural/OrganizeFoundationTypes/ (manifest.yml) assembly dbtools.OrganizeFoundationTypes entry OrganizeFoundationTypesCommand DESCRIPTION The organizer renames foundation types, sets their Type Mark and merges types with equal dimensions. The user page lists the families and output formats. STRUCTURE Path Owner App/Composition/ OrganizeFoundationTypesCommand declares its workflow with CommandService. App registers the service when it loads the ribbon item. Features/FoundationType/ OrganizeFoundationTypesWorkflow chooses the policy. FoundationTypePlanner selects renames and merges. FoundationTypeOrganizer reads and edits Revit types. Features/TypeMark/ TypeMarkPolicy selects overwrite or preserve. TypeMarkGenerator makes the marks. CONTRACTS CollectTypes matches FamilySymbol types in the document by category and exact family name using StringComparison.Ordinal. The workflow prompts only when a collected type has a nonblank Type Mark. Cancel or closing the alert returns before the workflow calls FoundationTypeOrganizer.Run. OrganizeFoundationTypesTests checks both cases and the mark choices. Inside dbtools - Organize Foundation Types, the organizer calls ApplyAtomicTypeChange once for a retained type's mark and rename. MergeInstances calls it once per duplicate source type for all its ChangeTypeId calls. TransactionExecutor.RunSubTransaction handles each nested call. OrganizeFoundationTypesTests.Workflow_WhenTypeRenameFails_KeepsSourceAndReportsSkippedType checks the skip reported for a rejected name. A merge requires all dimensions to have values. Overwrite groups by exact stored dimensions. Preserve also groups by exact mark. Blank types join a marked group when the size has one distinct mark. The merge target is the type with the lowest element ID. In Preserve groups with marked types, the target is the marked type with the lowest element ID. MergeInstances must succeed before the organizer deletes a source type. The organizer merges the group before attempting to rename the target. FoundationTypePlannerTests checks the mark and dimension rules. OrganizeFoundationTypesTests checks that Revit reassigns the instances before deleting a merged type and that the target can then use its name. FLOW ResolveTypeMarkPolicy maps Overwrite Existing Marks and Preserve Existing Marks to TypeMarkPolicy. With all marks blank, Execute selects OverwriteExistingTypeMarks directly. Each family scheme supplies the dimension parameters, sort key, mark generator and name format. The organizer sorts the types in ascending order for each family and uses the element ID to break ties. Family Dimension key Sort Foundation Pier b, h b × h, then the dimensions in key order Foundation Pier - Round d d Footing-Rectangular, Pile Cap-Rectangular Width, Length, Foundation Thickness The dimensions in key order Preserve reserves existing marks across all four families and processes marked types before blank types. Overwrite assigns marks in size order and reserves the old mark of a type when a rename or merge fails. Rename and merge callbacks apply each change once. The workflow shows renamed, merged and skipped counts. If a skipped type keeps a mark already assigned in the run, the dialog and log report the mark and both type IDs. DATA FoundationTypeOrganizer.SetParam requires writable text storage for an assigned Type Mark and reports a rejected write. FormatLength requests UnitTypeId.FeetFractionalInches for the name. Grouping uses the stored dimensions to preserve instance geometry. If a dimension is missing or unreadable, the rename stops before the organizer writes the name or mark. The skip detail identifies the parameter. The organizer shares the warning defined by dbtools.FoundationTags. The OrganizeFoundationTypes entry in build/Distribution/tool-contracts.json records the family names in column_families and foundation_families, plus type_mark_parameter and skipped_log. ToolContractsTests.EveryTextEqualsAStringValueOfItsToolSourceFiles searches the entry's full source_files list for each contract string. The list includes manifest.yml and FoundationTypeOrganizer.cs. Each value must match a string in at least one listed file. DIAGNOSTICS [OrganizeFoundations] reports the skipped count at Warning with up to five type IDs and reasons. A deletion error is logged and aborts the transaction. TESTS ./test.sh test --tool OrganizeFoundationTypes --scope pure ./test.sh test --tool OrganizeFoundationTypes --scope local -y 2026 TypeMarkGeneratorTests checks numbering. OrganizeFoundationTypesWorkflowTests checks how alert results map to policies. OrganizeFoundationTypesCommandTests checks the command attributes. OrganizeFoundationTypesTests uses gm_test_model.rvt and a rectangular pier made from a Structural Column family template. SEE ALSO Feature Warnings, Testing Tools

developer-guide/tools/structural/sgt.htm.title: dbtools.SGT | dbtools
developer-guide/tools/structural/sgt.htm.summary: dbtools.SGT NAME dbtools.SGT - the assembly behind Super Girt Tool SYNOPSIS source src/Tools/Structural/SGT/ (manifest.yml) assembly dbtools.SGT (net10.0-windows; net10.0 portable build for pure tests) entry SgtToolModule command SgtCommand (run profile InlineUi) hook ContextualEditHook (Edit SGT Wall on Modify | Structural Framing) window App/Views/SgtWindow.xaml (raw embedded XAML; sandbox window dbtools.SGT.Main) stable src/dbtools.Presentation/Tools/SGT/, src/dbtools.Presentation/StructuralPreview/ DESCRIPTION SgtCommand launches NewSessionWorkflow, which calls SgtWindowSession.RunModalFlowAsync. ContextualEditHook calls it directly with a WindowSessionLaunchRequest: New with a wall target, or Edit with a SystemId. The session owns one transaction group for the life of the modal window. Wall analysis builds a Plan; the window edits it through PlanStore; preview and placement read the same resolved member contracts. The user page describes the behavior, and Structural Preview the 3D host. STRUCTURE Paths are under src/Tools/Structural/SGT/. Path Contents App/Composition/ SgtToolModule, SgtCommand, ContextualEdit/ and every service registration (ServiceCollectionExtensions and the feature *ServiceCollectionExtensions). App/Startup/, App/Sessions/ NewSessionWorkflow, StartupAnalysisWorkflow, SgtWindowSession, WindowSessionLifecycle, WindowSessionBuilder, SessionAnalysisOwner. App/State/PlanSynchronization/ PlanSynchronizationCoordinator writes grid values into the plan. App/Views/, App/ViewModels/ SgtWindow, SgtWindowViewModel, and the preview view and presenter. The presenter is in App because it routes grid input through WindowSessionSurfaceCoordinator. Domain/ Plan, PlanStore, geometry, segmentation, gaps and resolved member contracts. Features/ BulkEdit, ChangeReview, Girt, Openings, Orientation, Placement, Preview, SegmentFlyout, WallAnalysis. Revit code is in their Revit/ folders. Persistence/ SystemStorageMapper, StoredSystem, ISystemRepository, Revit/SystemRepository, Revit/SgtSchemaContract, ElementTagSchema. Revit/ Shared adapters: family symbols, framing parameters and wall frames. TemporaryTransactionRunner rolls back probe edits; CommittedWrite runs a write that must commit, and maps a refusal to Transaction/NotCommitted. Presentation holds the stable WPF side: the grid and preview behaviors and drag input in Tools/SGT/, and the Helix viewport behind IStructuralPreview3D. SGT code has no Helix reference. PreviewLengthFormatter formats girt segment lengths and wall layer thicknesses in preview tooltips. It rounds to one decimal place in inches and carries 12.0 inches to the next foot. Wall layer labels show inches alone below one foot. CONTRACTS One session group. SgtWindowSession.Start refuses an IRevitCallGate whose RunsInline is false, and a document whose IsModifiable is true, because a transaction is already open. It begins the group Super Girt Tool, then runs PurgeUnsupportedAsync inside it. A command uses ordinary transactions inside the group, and never starts or ends a group of its own. SgtWindowSessionTests checks the refusals. Commit only on success. WindowSessionLifecycle.FinalizeSession assimilates the group only when all of these hold: the close requests a commit, startup succeeded, no failure is recorded, and IsGroupHealthyAsync is true. Every other end rolls back: Cancel, the window's close box, a failed command, a handled UI error, and retirement of the window by its shell. WindowSessionLifecycleTests checks this. Plan admission. PlanStore.Initialize and Update change a detached copy and validate it with PlanAdmissionValidator before they replace the plan. A rejected or unchanged candidate keeps the plan and its Version. PlanStoreUpdatePolicyTests and PlanAdmissionValidatorTests check this. One segmentation. GirtSegmentBoundarySet.Split is the only girt segment computation. Plan-row segmentation, the preview, placement and the usable-span check all call it. Jamb extent resolution uses these spans to find girts that reach each jamb. A failed span lookup identifies the girt and endpoint. OpeningSegmentationReconciler splits usable pieces outside the default jamb span and preserves manual joints. It ends an extension 1/2" from the girt face when the next piece cannot fit. The requested mode and target remain the inputs to each recompute. The effective end supplies the preview status and the placed geometry. GirtSegmentBoundarySetTests checks the rules, and PreviewPlacementParityTests the shared use. One resolved member. ResolvedMemberContractResolver builds one ResolvedMemberContract per member, and OpeningMemberContractCatalog lists the opening segments once. WallFrameBuilder locates the wall center from the Revit side faces. It transforms linked faces into host coordinates and pairs side planes separated by the full compound thickness. It sums coplanar face areas on each side, then compares the smaller area of each pair first and the larger area second. A tie between distinct exterior planes or a missing pair fails wall analysis. A slanted or tapered cross-section also fails. WallTargetFrameBuilder adds WallOffsetFeet to the exterior face of the selected layer. The target plane serves analysis, preview and placement. The preview modes and WallSystemWriter read these values and compute no transform of their own. DirectionalGapEvaluator measures the gap at a jamb in the wall's along direction. PreviewPlacementParityTests compares the preview with the placed members. It measures the Section anchors and placed location lines against the selected layer plane. It checks section seating, channel toe direction and Z flange heights, and it measures two sizes of the same channel family on a compound wall. It measures placed header and sill clearances at jambs in every representative state and girt clearances in the seeded states. Framing analysis and write order. WallAnalysisFramingTypeAnalyzer groups types by family and cross-section shape. Square and rectangular HSS form separate groups. The analyzer calibrates one sample and solves each eligible role. Probe inputs are the type parameter values and the initial instance parameter values and Flip capability for the role's probe axis. They exclude Revit identity metadata and IFC export GUIDs. A type can reuse a failed role from the sample or from a previous variant with matching inputs. Each type verifies inherited settings against its own geometry. If those settings fail seating or the probe inputs differ, the analyzer solves only failed roles and verifies the new settings on the existing profile probes. FamilyOrientationAnalyzer checks visible framing solids against the target and role planes. The target plane allows 0.0005 ft of modelling tolerance. The geometry reader excludes solids identified as non-steel and lists their material names and classes if every visible solid is excluded. A channel jamb must have a measured toe direction away from the opening. A Z girt seats its exterior flange below its interior flange. An angle girt seats the back of its long leg flat on the target plane, facing the exterior, with the short leg at the bottom toward the interior. The analyzer captures each type's profile and reads its Start and End Extension limits in a rollback transaction. For each rotation and Flip, it measures the separate Y and Z justification translations and combines them for mixed settings. It checks that the samples share the same pose, section axes and outline. It measures solved defaults directly on Revit geometry to check seating and verifies the combined profiles for mixed defaults against those measurements. A saved row outside the orientation catalog can still supply a profile. The session reuses results while the type parameter values, target frame and sample settings match. The writer checks the recorded extension limits for each girt segment before member writes. Profile warming and placement set rotation, Flip, Y and Z justification, then zero the offsets. Jambs add the WallRotationCompensationEvaluator angle to the rotation. The grid shows 0, 90, 180 or 270. The writer regenerates the batch before it records the placed endpoints. FramingTypeProbeBudgetTests checks the analysis cost, and FamilyInstanceMutatorTests checks the written parameters. Storage format. SystemStorageMapper reads and writes format version 3 only. Every transport field is JsonRequired. It rejects unknown fields, numeric enum tokens and payloads over 4,000,000 characters. It migrates nothing: PurgeUnsupportedAsync removes the storage and member tags of other formats, and the tags of systems with no current storage. It keeps the members. SystemStorageMapperTests and SystemRepositoryTests check this. Ownership. SgtSchemaContract.TryGetOwnedSystemId owns an element only if it is Structural Framing and its tag has the marker SGT and a system ID. Selection, update, deletion and deconstruction use it. ContextualEditTargetEvaluatorTests checks this. Update by identity. WallSystemWriter indexes the owned members by role and tag identity. It compares each match's live curve, type, orientation, offsets, joins and girt extensions with the requested placement. It writes and reports a straight match as Moved when a value differs. It creates a member for a target without a match and deletes owned members that no target uses. Two owned members with one identity fail with Update/DuplicateIdentity.
